notes.title: "Hate You" Development News
notes.notes: [p]The developers of "Hate You" are in touch. We're happy to announce that the game is nearly finished and is currently being polished. We hope to release the full version in October![/p][p]After releasing the demo, we received a ton of feedback from you and are thrilled that you appreciated our work. This fuels our desire to create a high-quality and engaging product that every player will remember. Thank you again for your support![/p][p]Stay tuned for the game's release date soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584705/6ac4dd5464a1493fcc5e13420c99d93d3c33d10b.jpg"][/img][/p]
